title: FREQUENCY as a balancing lever: four CTRL land species at 100/50/25/12, every other land species at 1, all four stocked at 500; the surface released every 1,500 ticks. Wave shares vs the wiki model (uniform pick from the region list, accept on d100 <= FREQUENCY).
fork: share proportional to FREQUENCY (the wiki's rejection model) or not

predictions.expects: shares ~ f/sum(f): 53/27/13/6% of the four (plus a little for the frequency-1 others)

kill_criterion: the order of shares does not follow the order of FREQUENCY
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: f100_50_25_12
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; cfg.enabled=false; cfg.groups.enabled=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.disableSched(); print('tool disarmed')

local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local rs=sw.getEmbarkRegions(); local want={}; for _,t in ipairs({'KANGAROO','PORCUPINE','WOMBAT','EMU'}) do want[t]=true end; local n=0; for _,pop in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do local cr=df.creature_raw.find(pop.race); if cr and want[cr.creature_id] and sw.managedPop(pop, rs, sw.LAYER_SET.land) then pop.quantity=500; pop.flags.extinct=false; n=n+1 end end; print(('eco: %d entries stocked at 500'):format(n))

local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local rs=sw.getEmbarkRegions(); local land={}; for _,pop in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do if sw.managedPop(pop, rs, sw.LAYER_SET.land) and df.world_population_type[pop.type]=='Animal' then land[pop.race]=true end end; local n,o=0,0; for i,cr in ipairs(df.global.world.raws.creatures.all) do if false then elseif cr.creature_id=='KANGAROO' then cr.frequency=100; n=n+1 elseif cr.creature_id=='PORCUPINE' then cr.frequency=50; n=n+1 elseif cr.creature_id=='WOMBAT' then cr.frequency=25; n=n+1 elseif cr.creature_id=='EMU' then cr.frequency=12; n=n+1 elseif land[i] then cr.frequency=1; o=o+1 end end; print(('eco: %d named species set, %d other land species at frequency 1'):format(n,o))
